text:
molly: ok quick watercooler: one song/episode/album that absolutely powers you through a 90-min sprint? prefer something that doesn't need attention (background-able). drop one and why.

devin: Song: "Midnight City" - M83. instant momentum, no lyrics to distract. great for refactors. :rocket:

ash: Album: "LP1" - FKA twigs. moody but rhythmic, helps me focus on tiny bugs.

ash: (also throwing a short TV pick) The Great British Bake Off S3E1  60min zen, oddly calming while waiting for long tests.

ash: code tip: if you want a 90-min playlist, I run `spotify --shuffle --limit 90m` (pseudo) and it does the job.

pete: guilty-pleasure single: "Toxic" - Britney. sing in my head, then code. zero shame. :microphone:

musicbot: [AUTO] Curated short-sprint playlist generated: https://tiny.redwood/sprint-90 (placeholder)

molly: love the Bake Off rec. also anyone with an instrumental-only rec?

devin: instrumentals: Explosions in the Sky  their album "The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place" is perfect background.

pete: instrumental single: "An Ending (Ascent)"  Brian Eno. tiny emotional lift without words.

ash: ep rec for a 30-min break: Black Mirror S1E1  quick, bite-sized brain twist.

molly: vote to pin this thread to #watercooler-playlists. these are great.

devin: small note: if you're pairing music with pair-programming, skip heavy vocals  saves everyone. :sweat_smile:

giphy-bot: [GIF: tiny dj spinning records  party but calm]

molly: thanks y'all, saving the playlist and the Bake Off ep for later. will report results from tonight's sprint. :headphones:
